## Clinical Details

An 80-year-old woman with iron-deficiency anaemia and a caecal mass identified at colonoscopy. Right hemicolectomy performed; specimen submitted for staging.

## Macroscopic

A right hemicolectomy specimen 240 mm in length bearing a 45 mm ulcerated tumour in the caecum, 30 mm from the ileocaecal valve. The tumour invades through the muscularis propria into pericolic fat. Twenty-two lymph nodes are recovered.

## Microscopic

A moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma invading pericolic adipose tissue. Lymphovascular invasion is present. Three of twenty-two lymph nodes contain metastatic carcinoma. Resection margins are clear.

## Conclusion

Caecal adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated, pT3 N1 M0. Mismatch-repair immunohistochemistry is retained.
